//: Preset for a shared library package under packages/*. Pure ESM, emits declarations, composite so it can be a TypeScript project reference. It carries ONLY location-independent compilerOptions: path-bearing options (rootDir, outDir, tsBuildInfoFile) and file globs (include/exclude) must live in the CONSUMING package's tsconfig, because relative paths in an extended base resolve to the base's directory, not the consumer's.
